drawn_objects: No annotations by Ace at all - this is an unmodified screenshot of the Yahoo Finance quote page.
Yahoo 'Mountain' area chart in red (down day) with a grey volume histogram along the bottom.
Grey dashed previous-close line at 4,896.20 and green dashed last-price line at 4,565.60 with a red marker dot, both drawn automatically by Yahoo.
chart.visible_date_range: One intraday session; the quote is stamped 'As of 9:42:34 AM EDT. Market Open.' The calendar date is not printed on the page.
chart.what_the_drawing_says: Nothing was drawn - the image is evidence, not analysis. It shows COMEX Gold Apr 26 futures down 331.40 (-6.77%) on the day at 4,564.80, having fallen from about 4,890 at the open to a spike low near 4,500 before stabilising around 4,565. It is posted to support his claim that he sold gold at 5150.

notes: All chat text and the whole Yahoo Finance block are fully legible at zoom (high confidence). THE CRITICAL CAVEAT ON THIS IMAGE: the 21:55 gold message is explicitly marked '(edited)' by Discord, so its current wording - including the '5150' sell price - may not be what was originally posted, and it cannot be treated as a timestamped real-time call. Flagging this is material because it is the only evidence for the gold claim. Second caveat: the '5150' sell price is asserted in TEXT ONLY. The attached screenshot shows the CURRENT quote (4,564.80, -331.40, -6.77%, previous close 4,896.20) and contains no order, fill, position or account evidence - nothing in the image corroborates a sale at 5150, and 5150 is well above the 4,896.20 previous close shown, i.e. it would have to have been an earlier-session exit. Do NOT treat 5150 as verified. Note also the units: GC=F at ~4,565 is a COMEX gold futures price per troy ounce. TIMESTAMP GAP: the top message 'Added insane buy position at 1.45 for XRP' has its header scrolled off the top of the screenshot - only the bottom 2-3 pixel rows of the date/time glyphs survive and they are not legible, so its timestamp is set to null rather than guessed. Worth pairing with IMG_7808/7809 where on 17/03 he wrote 'xrp at 1.38 was a steal'; here he is adding at 1.45, i.e. a higher add. The two coloured price tags on the gold chart are Yahoo's own automatic previous-close and last-price lines; they are recorded in drawn_levels for completeness but explicitly marked as NOT Ace's annotations, and the plain values 4,800.00 / 4,700.00 / 4,600.00 / 4,500.00 are ordinary axis gridlines and are excluded. Minor internal note: the quote is stamped 9:42:34 AM EDT while the Discord message is timestamped 21:55 local - not a contradiction, just a delay between capture and posting, but the exact offset is not determinable from the image. Reaction emoji on the 09:40 message renders as a saluting face with count 2. Spelling, spacing and punctuation left verbatim (double space in 'gold maxi ?  ... undefeated').
